name: make-note-for-video
title: Video Notes
description: Take notes with a timecode and frame from IINA or a browser video, and export them to an HTML table
author: mikeozornin

commands.name: new-session
commands.title: New Video Review
commands.description: Create a review folder with notes.md and make it active

commands.name: continue-session
commands.title: Continue Video Review
commands.description: Pick an existing review and make it active

commands.name: add-note
commands.title: Video Note
commands.description: Pause, capture timecode and frame, add a comment to notes.md. Start with -- for a general note

commands.name: build-html
commands.title: Build Video Notes HTML
commands.description: Build index.html from notes.md and zip it

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
